column1: # The test suite, one list played the same way locally and in CI (Mission 188).
# Played by tests/run-suite.sh (and tests/run-suite.ps1 on Windows); CI calls those runners, it no longer lists tests.
# Columns, tab-separated, "-" for an empty field:
#   path          file to run, relative to the repository root
#   interpreter   bash | bash+uv (bash, uv put on PATH first, as the guardians need) | uv-python (uv run --no-project) | ps1 (powershell -File on Windows, pwsh -File elsewhere)
#   platforms     W = Windows, U = Ubuntu, M = macOS; a letter followed by ! (W!UM) marks the test REQUIRED on that platform: its SKIP (exit 77) is a blocking FAIL (Mission 237)

#   severity      blocking (a red one fails the run) | informational (reported, never fails the run -- the former continue-on-error steps) | on-demand (Mission 234: played only with --on-demand / -OnDemand, and then alone; never by default, never by CI)
#   origin        the Mission that brought the test and what it proves; a leading "+" marks a line added after the frozen reference tests/fixtures/ci-42f74e6a-steps.tsv

#   shard         Windows lines only: the CI shard that plays the line (1..3, Mission 189), balanced on the durations measured in CI run 35349101214 with the two guardians together in shard 1; "-" elsewhere. `--shard k/n` plays shard k only.
# A test may exit 77 to report SKIP (cause printed by the test itself).
